segments.title: Group boxes on hover
segments.body: A group's box only shows while the pointer is over it, and a nested group first in line sits a row gap below its parent's header.

segments.title: Extensions in Little Ardia
segments.body: An extension's popup opens in Little Ardia too, from its shortcut or when the extension asks. It used to open nowhere.

segments.title: Paste the link
segments.body: A link copied with its title pastes as the URL, and line breaks in pasted text fold away the way Chrome's address bar does it.
segments.afterOnly: 0.2.41-nightly.2 pasted the link's title and turned line breaks into spaces. The release build shares the Mac's real clipboard, so a test instance can't film it.

segments.title: ⌘S stays with the page
segments.body: In a page's text field or editor, ⌘S goes to the page. Press it twice quickly to hide the sidebar.

segments.title: Back after a relaunch
segments.body: Quit and open Ardia again: each tab still remembers where it's been, so Back takes you there.

segments.title: Arc favorites stay favorites
segments.body: An Arc favorite that also sits in a pinned row or folder comes in as a tile. It used to go missing from the top.
